periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal axis, converging toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology, vertically elongated with a height-to-width ratio greater than 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with the inferior margin extending significantly below the geometric center of the eye patch.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation, estimated at approximately twice the horizontal width of an individual ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Uniformly smooth, convex semicircular profile at the superior margin.
